description: This file defines the `ChannelId` struct, which uniquely identifies a communication channel within the Orleans broadcast system. It includes methods for creating, comparing, and serializing channel identifiers, as well as internal structures for internal use. It also includes a related `InternalChannelId` struct for internal identification purposes.

classes.name: ChannelId
classes.description: A readonly struct that encapsulates the identification of a broadcast channel, supporting serialization, comparison, and formatting.

classes.name: InternalChannelId
classes.description: An internal readonly struct pairing a ChannelId with a provider name for internal identification within the Orleans broadcast system.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a ChannelId from namespace and key (either spans, GUID, or strings).

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this ChannelId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the fullKey.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the key component as UTF-8 string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component as UTF-8 string, or null if none.
